note: get_primary_keys_for_schemas drops its inline information_schema query and calls the existing get_primary_key_columns helper.
Plan doc guidelines rewritten so per-product directories live under src/ingestion/pipelines/<name>/ instead of lanes/.
Adds DEFAULT_BUCKET_OPTION derived from BUCKET_OPTIONS; DEFAULT_BUCKET_MINUTES, DEFAULT_CONFIG and getBucketOption fallback now derive from it.
Throttles verification token last_used_at updates via a cache sentinel and makes apply_provisioning_defaults public; blocklist storage untouched.
Renames the GET-only tuple to GET_DOWNGRADE_ACTIONS with a method-aware comment and restructures the permission gating around it.
Creates constants.tsx exporting MATCHING_ESTIMATE_TOOLTIP JSX and replaces both inline tooltip copies with it.
Only removes UrlFetchFailedError/EmptyContentError except branches from two view actions; no validated_request decorator introduced.
Removes the runtime fetch of protected-resource metadata and derives MCP consent scopes locally from committed tool definitions and supported scopes.
Changes Event::headers to return CapturedEventHeaders and removes build_context_headers; serialize_into still returns Result<(), String>.
Removes the standalone DebugSymbols command and exposes native ELF upload as an Upload subcommand of symbol-sets.
Moves the cookieless Redis pool and manager into the shared services scope of the combined server; servers are not split per pipeline.
Extracts a shared _map_arrow_type helper used by both the constructor loop and add_field, removing the duplicated type mapping.
Makes build_command optional/nullable with inferred defaults; the github_pat serializer field remains.
Replaces both table constants with a single WAREHOUSE_SOURCE_SETUP map keyed by signal source, including the CI tables.
Moves SDK_TYPES into backend constants so the API module no longer imports from the dags module.
Renames lanes/ to pipelines/ with single-word names; logs and traces stay under src/ingestion/pipelines/logs.
Adds bypass_warehouse_access_control param to to_printed_hogql and uses it instead of building a HogQLContext manually.
Removes set_pending (and reconcile/paused tracking); callers re-absorb still-full holdovers via absorb.
Renames the helper to _maybe_create_provisioned_pat; the gate stays inside the function rather than moving to call sites.
Adds a kind label to the db write failure counter, classifying errors as transient or logical via a new isTransientPgError helper.
